test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following are eligible for the training programs under Deen Dayal Upadhyay – Gramin Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)?

options.text: Individuals between the ages of 15 and 35 years
Individuals between the ages of 15 and 25 years
Individuals between the ages of 18 and 35 years
Individuals between the ages of 25 and 55 years

solution:
The correct answer is __**Individuals between the ages of 15 and 35 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Deen Dayal Upadhyay – Gramin Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)** is a flagship program under the **Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD)**, Government of India. It aims to provide skill training to rural youth to enhance their employability.
 
• The program is specifically designed for **individuals aged between 15 and 35 years**. This age group is considered ideal for acquiring skills and entering the workforce. *Hence, the eligibility criteria mentioned in the correct option are accurate.*
 
• **Special provisions:** For certain categories like **Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), and Persons with Disabilities (PwDs)**, the upper age limit has been relaxed up to **45 years**.
 
• The program targets youth from **Below Poverty Line (BPL) households**, households with **National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (NREGA) job card holders**, and other disadvantaged sections of society.
 
• The training program under DDU-GKY is designed to address the skill gap among rural youth and prepare them for **industry-relevant job roles**. It includes classroom training, practical sessions, and on-the-job training.
 
• The program ensures placement support after completion of the training, with a focus on wage employment in various sectors.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Individuals between the ages of 15 and 35 years.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Overview of DDU-GKY:**

 
 
• **DDU-GKY** was launched on **25th September 2014**, coinciding with the birth anniversary of Pandit **Deen Dayal Upadhyay**. It is part of the National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM).
 
• The scheme aims to skill rural youth in various domains like **healthcare, construction, retail, hospitality, and IT/ITES**, helping them secure sustainable livelihoods.
 
• It emphasizes the inclusion of socially disadvantaged groups such as **women, minorities, SC/ST, and PwDs**, ensuring equitable access to opportunities.
 
 
 
• **Eligibility Criteria:**
 
 
• **Age:** The standard age limit for eligibility is **15 to 35 years**. However, relaxations are provided for vulnerable groups, extending the upper age limit to **45 years**.
 
• **Socio-economic status:** Priority is given to individuals from **BPL families**, households with **NREGA job card holders**, or families identified by the **Social Economic Caste Census (SECC)**.
 
 
 
• **Training Features:**
 
 
• **Duration:** Training programs typically range from **3 to 12 months**, depending on the skill sector.
 
• It includes practical training sessions, industry exposure, and soft skills development, along with **digital literacy**.
 
• Placement support is provided, with a focus on securing wage employment in sectors such as **retail, manufacturing, healthcare, and IT**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Implementation:**

 
 
• **DDU-GKY** works through a network of **Project Implementing Agencies (PIAs)**. These agencies are responsible for training delivery, placement, and post-placement support.
 
• The program is monitored by state rural livelihood missions to ensure quality and transparency.
 
 
 
• **Achievements:**
 
 
• Since its inception, DDU-GKY has trained and placed thousands of rural youth, contributing to **employment generation** and rural development.
 
• It has partnered with various industries and organizations to ensure training aligns with **market demands**.
